architectural_fidelity.reason: Room architecture is correctly preserved: same sloped ceiling with dormer window, white/gray walls maintained, door on right wall present, stairwell railing visible in foreground, window position and size accurate, camera angle matches original loft perspective.

furniture_removal.reason: Original furniture not fully removed - black ottoman/storage boxes from original are still visible in foreground left, creating phantom remnants that should have been completely cleared for a professional staging.

style_commitment.reason: COVABOHEMIAN style present but not fully committed: neutral gray-beige palette dominates, some bohemian elements (plants, textured textiles, gallery wall) exist but lack the bold color, pattern layering, and eclectic maximalism expected of confident boho styling.

editorial_density.reason: Achieves editorial density with gallery wall art, multiple plants (window sill, floor, vanity), layered bed textiles (duvet, throw), decorative mirror, desk styling, throw blanket on chair, various lighting sources - meets Architectural Digest baseline.

photorealism.reason: Generally photorealistic with natural lighting and materials, but some elements show minor CGI softness (particularly bed linens and floor ottoman area) and slight blur/depth-of-field inconsistencies compared to Collov's crisp rendering quality.

designer_preference_reason: Cova fails the critical furniture removal gate with visible original remnants, making it unpresentable to clients despite its editorial styling attempts.
what_cova_does_better: Preserves the actual loft architecture with sloped ceilings and dormer
Maintains authentic room proportions and spatial relationships
Incorporates more varied plant selection and organic styling elements
what_collov_does_better: Complete furniture removal with pristine base preparation
Sharper photorealistic rendering quality without soft CGI feel
Cleaner execution and professional polish suitable for client presentation
specific_fixes_if_failing: CRITICAL: Remove all original furniture remnants - the black ottoman/storage boxes in foreground left must be completely eliminated
Strengthen bohemian style commitment with bolder textiles, richer earth tones, and pattern mixing (moroccan rugs, macrame, colorful throws)
Improve rendering sharpness particularly on textiles and eliminate depth-of-field blur inconsistencies for true photorealism
